Terms

Terms and conditions

Plain-English terms for Anderseed Consulting resources, mentorship applications, payment, refunds, and programme participation.

Last updated: July 2026. This page is a practical working draft and should be professionally reviewed before launch.

Services

Anderseed Consulting provides mentorship and career education relating to Business Analysis. Services may include live sessions, resources, CV and LinkedIn support, interview preparation, community access, and career guidance.

No employment guarantee

We do not guarantee employment, interviews, salary outcomes, or specific results. Outcomes depend on your effort, prior experience, market conditions, applications, interview performance, and hiring decisions outside our control.

Enrolment

Cohort places are confirmed after payment or approved payment arrangement. Places may be limited to preserve learner support and feedback quality.

Payments

Payment options may include card payment, Klarna where available, or bank transfer. Bank transfer references should include your full name and BA Mentorship so payments can be matched correctly.

Refunds

You have a 14-day cooling-off period from purchase under the Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013. Request a refund within 14 days and before the cohort start date for a full refund. If sessions or services have already been delivered at your request within that period, a proportionate amount may be deducted.

After 14 days or once the cohort has begun, fees are non-refundable except where required by law. Individual services such as CV writing, CV review, interview preparation, and LinkedIn review are non-refundable once delivered.

Materials

Programme recordings, templates, resources, and community materials are for personal use only. They may not be copied, shared, resold, or used to create competing services.

Conduct

Learners are expected to behave respectfully in sessions and community spaces. We may remove access where behaviour is abusive, disruptive, or harmful to other learners.

Your data

Personal data is handled in line with the privacy notice.
